description: Election Commission - Appointed Elwala Gedara Sithara Dilrukshi Nissanka as the member of the Pallepola Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pallepola Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member by a recognized political party, which directly relates to electoral processes and local government representation.
